title: Analysis by Merrick's colleagues points to a Tic Tac-shaped craft

tellings.quote: but I have fairly high confidence that that was a tick tap shake craft

related.note: An analysis of the same FLIR1 footage that concludes it shows a Tic Tac-shaped craft, against telling 6's distant aircraft.

plain: The object in the FLIR1 video, an infrared clip a Navy jet recorded in 2004 over the Pacific off Southern California, was a "Tic Tac shaped craft": a white oval object shaped like the mint. The guest Marik von Rennenkampff says he has "fairly high confidence" in this, resting it on analysis by an unnamed California scientist, during an episode where he faces the skeptic Mick West, who reads the same footage as a distant aircraft or a balloon. If true, it would mean the video shows a real craft of unusual shape.
